stages.prompt: Read the item and tree. To divide the work, write the optional proposal output targeting work with workflow build-pieces@v1 and args.pieces, a list of at most 12 objects in execution order. Each object has id, seat, access (read_only or write), prompt, optional outputs mapping names to types, and for write access a nonempty write_scope within the item's fence. Read-only pieces must omit write_scope. Choose seats mapped by policy and do not assign writes to read-only seats. If no division is useful, propose nothing. When a piece cannot be cut without a design decision, write no proposal and end your report with OBSTACLE: owner, a QUESTION: line containing the one specific question, and RESULT: blocked. Do not write or commit repository files.

Read the criteria, joined candidate diff and the producers' outputs. For each criterion marked done, name the satisfying piece as node:<id> in evidence. For each criterion no piece covers, mark it not-done with a reason beginning uncovered:. The gate and judge still decide landing.
